cyberblock.loading.tip.1: Press F9 any time to switch Cyberblock off and play plain Cyberpunk.
cyberblock.loading.tip.2: Esc opens the Night City pause menu. Night City Menu... there opens Cyberpunk's own.
cyberblock.loading.tip.3: Scan with G, then pick a quickhack. Every hack costs RAM.
cyberblock.loading.tip.4: Blocks you place become real walls in Night City: build yourself a staircase.
cyberblock.loading.tip.5: Press M for the Atlas and J for your jobs.
cyberblock.loading.tip.6: Press U to install the cyberware you have crafted.
cyberblock.loading.tip.7: An elytra or a wind charge is the fastest way over Night City's rooftops.
cyberblock.loading.tip.8: F5 swaps to third person. The camera options are under Esc, Cyberblock...
